name: 반전세계
prompt:
STYLE LOCK — Crystal Quest Painterly World Map.
Use the attached chapter-1-library-map.webp as the authoritative STYLE reference. Match its rendering, color relationships, material treatment, detail density and atmospheric depth, not its specific library building or geography.
Create a finely hand-painted premium fantasy mobile RPG world map. Use soft controlled painterly brush texture, delicate colored edges without black outlines, dimensional cream stone, naturally layered cliffs, nuanced lush foliage, tiny flowers and climbing ivy. Use warm sunlight, cool teal-violet shadows, golden paths, turquoise water where appropriate, blue atmospheric distance and softly billowing white clouds. Violet-blue crystals have translucent faceted surfaces, white highlights and restrained magical glow; gold is a restrained waypoint accent.
Use an elevated three-quarter map view, clear destination architecture, readable winding routes, crisp nearby terrain and softer lower-contrast distant scenery. Keep navigation landmarks distinct at portrait mobile size. The image must look like another region painted by the same artist as the style reference. Preserve the region's own subject and geography rather than copying the reference's buildings.


Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Wordoria Crystal Quest story world map, now designated World 6A — Inverted World (월드 6A · 반전세계).
Reference roles: Image 1 is chapter-1-library-map.webp, authoritative painterly STYLE reference only. Image 2 is the actual EDIT TARGET and authoritative geometry/layout. Edit Image 2; do not recreate Image 1 geography.
Primary request: change ONLY the colors of the 20 waypoint crystals and the complete traversable road to PURPLE. All 20 crystals must be rich amethyst purple with lavender-white highlights and violet glow, avoiding cyan/blue crystal bodies. Recolor the entire walking surface along the existing winding route, including ALL connecting bridges, stair treads and the final portal landing, from yellow/tan/gray to clear luminous lavender-violet stone. The purple roadway must be visibly continuous from the first crystal to the last crystal and stand out from the darker blue surroundings. Retain individually painted stone details; avoid neon featureless ribbons. Keep restrained gold pedestal rims.
Preserve exactly the current moonlit dark background, trees, cliffs, waterfalls, distant buildings, fog, ruined arches, portal, light sources, camera, framing and 1:3 portrait aspect ratio. Do not change geography or add new upside-down features just because the world is renamed. Preserve all twenty crystal locations, sizes and the complete path topology. Do not add text for the new title; the new designation belongs in metadata, not in the art.
User overrides to the fixed style block: this specific map stays DARK NIGHT, not daytime. The road and crystals are PURPLE, not golden road or blue crystal. All surrounding scenery stays unchanged.
Composition: preserve 724 x 2172 portrait dimensions if supported, no crop.
Gameplay contract: exactly 20 distinct crystal waypoints on gold-rimmed circular pedestals. Normalized crystal centers in stage order: 1: (18.741%, 6.738%); 2: (44.07%, 8.936%); 3: (69.693%, 10.986%); 4: (86.091%, 14.893%); 5: (64.861%, 17.48%); 6: (37.921%, 20.41%); 7: (17.862%, 24.072%); 8: (39.531%, 27.686%); 9: (66.471%, 30.518%); 10: (84.041%, 33.789%); 11: (65.154%, 37.402%); 12: (33.821%, 40.674%); 13: (16.105%, 43.799%); 14: (39.971%, 47.9%); 15: (66.618%, 51.855%); 16: (85.359%, 57.129%); 17: (64.275%, 62.5%); 18: (35.286%, 67.236%); 19: (18.302%, 73.877%); 20: (60.322%, 87.354%). Keep these positions and sizes fixed. No extra crystals or pedestal circles. Preserve original connected descent from top-left to bottom portal.

Avoid coarse low-poly geometry, chunky toy-like 3D rendering, plastic surfaces, flat oversaturated green terrain, black cartoon outlines, pixel art, gritty photorealism, muddy dark palettes, excessive bloom and repetitive noisy detail. No characters, monsters, text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, logos, watermark, frames or black side borders. Do not obscure the route or waypoint crystals with foliage, clouds or effects. Do not introduce buildings or narrative elements unrelated to the requested world.
coordinateMeasurement: Crystal centers visually rechecked against the edited output and prior 683x2048 measurements. Geometry preserved; normalized coordinates retained, with numbered overlay for verification.
